'''Darth Nul's archive''' was an ancient [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] structure where [[Darth Nul]] conserved some of her precious [[Force artifact/Legends|Force artifacts]].<ref name="TOR:OW" /> Centuries after the death of Darth Nul,<ref name="TOR:DN">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Darth Nul}}</ref> during the [[Third Galactic War]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tau Idair]] [[Duel in Darth Nul's archive|discovered]] [[Darth Nul's lightsaber]].<ref name="TOR:OW" />
